ex.en: I don't think this sponsor is very suitable.
ex.zh: 我覺得這家贊助商不太合適。

ex.en: The bank is the main sponsor of the marathon.
ex.zh: 這家銀行是馬拉松的主要贊助商。

ex.en: A local company sponsored the concert.
ex.zh: 一家本地公司贊助了這場音樂會。

ex.en: The event is sponsored by the city government.
ex.zh: 這場活動由市政府贊助。

ex.en: The team is looking for sponsorship.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍正在找贊助。

ex.en: The event was made possible by the sponsorship of several companies.
ex.zh: 多家公司的贊助讓這場活動得以舉辦。

ex.en: The living room in my new house is very spacious.
ex.zh: 我新家的客廳很寬敞。

ex.en: The hotel rooms are bright and spacious.
ex.zh: 飯店的房間明亮又寬敞。

ex.en: Please check the technical specifications before ordering.
ex.zh: 訂購前請確認技術規格。

ex.en: The product does not meet our specifications.
ex.zh: 這項產品不符合我們的規格。

ex.en: I sprained my finger while playing volleyball.
ex.zh: 我打排球的時候扭傷了手指。

ex.en: Tom sprained his wrist.
ex.zh: 湯姆扭傷了手腕。

ex.en: Tom sprained his ankle.
ex.zh: 湯姆扭傷了腳踝。

ex.en: Could you speak up? I can't hear you.
ex.zh: 可以說大聲一點嗎？我聽不到。

ex.en: Please speak up so everyone can hear.
ex.zh: 請說大聲一點，讓大家都聽得到。

ex.en: If you have any trouble, please speak up.
ex.zh: 有任何問題，請直接說出來。

ex.en: If you disagree, you should speak up.
ex.zh: 如果你不同意，就應該說出來。

ex.en: I don't know how to spell the word.
ex.zh: 我不知道這個單詞怎麼拼寫。

ex.en: Well, I'll tell you how to spell my name.
ex.zh: 好，我告訴你我的名字怎麼拼。

ex.en: That's not how my name is spelled.
ex.zh: 我的名字不是這樣拼的。

ex.en: I get dizzy spells when I stand up.
ex.zh: 我一站起來就覺得頭暈。

ex.en: We had a spell of cold weather last week.
ex.zh: 上週有一波寒流。

ex.en: The witch cast a spell on the prince.
ex.zh: 女巫對王子施了咒語。

ex.en: The music held the audience under its spell.
ex.zh: 音樂讓觀眾聽得如痴如醉。
